verses.greek: Λέγω οὖν, μὴ ἀπώσατο ὁ θεὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ; μὴ γένοιτο· καὶ γὰρ ἐγὼ Ἰσραηλίτης εἰμί, ἐκ σπέρματος Ἀβραάμ, φυλῆς Βενιαμίν.
verses.literal: I ask then not did reject the God the people of Him? Never would it be! Also for I myself an Israelite am of the seed of Abraham of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.dgt: I say then, God did not reject his people, did he? Certainly not! For I too am an Israelite, from the offspring of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.greek: οὐκ ἀπώσατο ὁ θεὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ ὃν προέγνω. ἢ οὐκ οἴδατε ἐν Ἠλίᾳ τί λέγει ἡ γραφή, ὡς ἐντυγχάνει τῷ θεῷ κατὰ τοῦ Ἰσραήλ;
verses.literal: Not did reject the God the people of Him whom He foreknew. Or not know you in Elijah what says the Scripture how he pleads the with God against the Israel
verses.dgt: God did not reject his people whom he foreknew. Or do you not know what Scripture says in the passage about Elijah, how he appeals to God against Israel?

verses.greek: Κύριε, τοὺς προφήτας σου ἀπέκτειναν, τὰ θυσιαστήριά σου κατέσκαψαν, κἀγὼ ὑπελείφθην μόνος, καὶ ζητοῦσιν τὴν ψυχήν μου.
verses.literal: Lord the prophets of You they have killed the altars of You they have torn down and I myself were left alone and they are seeking the life of me.
verses.dgt: “Lord, they killed your prophets, they tore down your altars, and I alone was left, and they are seeking my life.”

verses.greek: ἀλλὰ τί λέγει αὐτῷ ὁ χρηματισμός; Κατέλιπον ἐμαυτῷ ἑπτακισχιλίους ἄνδρας, οἵτινες οὐκ ἔκαμψαν γόνυ τῇ Βάαλ.
verses.literal: But what was spoken to him the divine answer? I have left to Myself seven thousand men who not bowed the knee the to Baal.
verses.dgt: But what does the divine response say to him? “I have left for myself seven thousand men who did not bow the knee to Baal.”

verses.greek: οὕτως οὖν καὶ ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ λεῖμμα κατʼ ἐκλογὴν χάριτος γέγονεν·
verses.literal: Thus then also in the present time a remnant according to the election of grace there has been.
verses.dgt: So then, also in the present time there has come to be a remnant according to election of grace.

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ χάριτι, οὐκέτι ἐξ ἔργων, ἐπεὶ ἡ χάρις οὐκέτι γίνεται χάρις.
verses.literal: If now by grace no longer from works otherwise the grace no longer would be grace
verses.dgt: But if by grace, it is no longer from works; otherwise grace is no longer grace.

verses.greek: τί οὖν; ὃ ἐπιζητεῖ Ἰσραήλ, τοῦτο οὐκ ἐπέτυχεν, ἡ δὲ ἐκλογὴ ἐπέτυχεν· οἱ δὲ λοιποὶ ἐπωρώθησαν,
verses.literal: What then? What is seeking Israel this not it has obtained the but the elect obtained it The now rest were hardened
verses.dgt: What then? What Israel seeks, this it did not obtain, but the chosen obtained it; and the rest were hardened,

verses.greek: καθὼς γέγραπται· Ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς πνεῦμα κατανύξεως, ὀφθαλμοὺς τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν καὶ ὦτα τοῦ μὴ ἀκούειν, ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας.
verses.literal: even as it has been written: Gave to them the God a spirit of stupor eyes the not to see and ears the not to hear unto the today day.
verses.dgt: just as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes so as not to see and ears so as not to hear, until this very day.”

verses.greek: καὶ Δαυὶδ λέγει· Γενηθήτω ἡ τράπεζα αὐτῶν εἰς παγίδα καὶ εἰς θήραν καὶ εἰς σκάνδαλον καὶ εἰς ἀνταπόδομα αὐτοῖς,
verses.literal: And David says: should be the table of them for a snare and for a trap and for a stumbling block and for a retribution to them
verses.dgt: And David says, “Let their table become a snare and a trap and a stumbling block and a repayment to them;

verses.greek: σκοτισθήτωσαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτῶν τοῦ μὴ βλέπειν, καὶ τὸν νῶτον αὐτῶν διὰ παντὸς σύγκαμψον.
verses.literal: should be darkened the eyes of them the not to see and the backs of them for all times do bend over.
verses.dgt: let their eyes be darkened so as not to see, and bend their back continually.”

verses.greek: Λέγω οὖν, μὴ ἔπταισαν ἵνα πέσωσιν; μὴ γένοιτο· ἀλλὰ τῷ αὐτῶν παραπτώματι ἡ σωτηρία τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, εἰς τὸ παραζηλῶσαι αὐτούς.
verses.literal: I say then surely not they did stumble so that they may fall? Never would it be! But in the of them trespass the is salvation to the Gentiles so as the to provoke to jealousy them.
verses.dgt: I say then, they did not stumble so as to fall, did they? Certainly not! But by their trespass salvation came to the Gentiles, to make them jealous.

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ τὸ παράπτωμα αὐτῶν πλοῦτος κόσμου καὶ τὸ ἥττημα αὐτῶν πλοῦτος ἐθνῶν, πόσῳ μᾶλλον τὸ πλήρωμα αὐτῶν.
verses.literal: If however the trespass of them is riches of the world and the failure of them is the riches of the Gentiles how much more the fullness of them?
verses.dgt: Now if their trespass is riches for the world and their failure riches for the Gentiles, how much more their fullness?

verses.greek: Ὑμῖν δὲ λέγω τοῖς ἔθνεσιν. ἐφʼ ὅσον μὲν οὖν εἰμι ἐγὼ ἐθνῶν ἀπόστολος, τὴν διακονίαν μου δοξάζω,
verses.literal: To you now I am speaking the Gentiles Upon as much as indeed therefore am I myself of the Gentiles apostle the ministry of mine I magnify
verses.dgt: Now I speak to you Gentiles. Insofar as I am an apostle of Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

verses.greek: εἴ πως παραζηλώσω μου τὴν σάρκα καὶ σώσω τινὰς ἐξ αὐτῶν.
verses.literal: if at all I will provoke to jealousy of me the flesh and will save some of them.
verses.dgt: if somehow I might make my flesh jealous and save some from among them.

verses.greek: εἰ γὰρ ἡ ἀποβολὴ αὐτῶν καταλλαγὴ κόσμου, τίς ἡ πρόσλημψις εἰ μὴ ζωὴ ἐκ νεκρῶν;
verses.literal: If for the rejection of them is the reconciliation of the world what will be the acceptance only except life out from the dead?
verses.dgt: For if their rejection is reconciliation of the world, what will their acceptance be if not life from the dead?

verses.greek: εἰ δὲ ἡ ἀπαρχὴ ἁγία, καὶ τὸ φύραμα· καὶ εἰ ἡ ῥίζα ἁγία, καὶ οἱ κλάδοι.
verses.literal: If now the firstfruit is holy also the lump and if the root is holy also the branches.
verses.dgt: And if the firstfruits are holy, so also the lump; and if the root is holy, so also the branches.

verses.greek: Εἰ δέ τινες τῶν κλάδων ἐξεκλάσθησαν, σὺ δὲ ἀγριέλαιος ὢν ἐνεκεντρίσθης ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ συγκοινωνὸς τῆς ῥίζης τῆς πιότητος τῆς ἐλαίας ἐγένου,
verses.literal: If however some of the branches were broken off you yourself now a wild olive tree being you were grafted in among them and a fellow-partaker of the root of the fatness of the olive tree you have become
verses.dgt: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became a fellow sharer of the root of the richness of the olive tree,

verses.greek: μὴ κατακαυχῶ τῶν κλάδων· εἰ δὲ κατακαυχᾶσαι, οὐ σὺ τὴν ῥίζαν βαστάζεις ἀλλὰ ἡ ῥίζα σέ.
verses.literal: not do boast over the branches If now you boast against them not you yourself the root support but the root you.
verses.dgt: do not boast against the branches. But if you boast, remember that you do not support the root, but the root supports you.

verses.greek: ἐρεῖς οὖν· Ἐξεκλάσθησαν κλάδοι ἵνα ἐγὼ ἐγκεντρισθῶ.
verses.literal: You will say then Were broken off branches that I myself may be grafted in.
verses.dgt: You will say then, “Branches were broken off so that I might be grafted in.”

verses.greek: καλῶς· τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ ἐξεκλάσθησαν, σὺ δὲ τῇ πίστει ἕστηκας. μὴ ὑψηλὰ φρόνει, ἀλλὰ φοβοῦ·
verses.literal: Rightly so by the unbelief they were broken off you yourself however the by faith have stood. Not high do be minded but do be afraid
verses.dgt: True. They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith. Do not think high things, but fear.

verses.greek: εἰ γὰρ ὁ θεὸς τῶν κατὰ φύσιν κλάδων οὐκ ἐφείσατο, οὐδὲ σοῦ φείσεται.
verses.literal: If for the God the according to nature branches not spared neither you will He spare.
verses.dgt: For if God did not spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

verses.greek: ἴδε οὖν χρηστότητα καὶ ἀποτομίαν θεοῦ· ἐπὶ μὲν τοὺς πεσόντας ἀποτομία, ἐπὶ δὲ σὲ χρηστότης θεοῦ, ἐὰν ἐπιμένῃς τῇ χρηστότητι, ἐπεὶ καὶ σὺ ἐκκοπήσῃ.
verses.literal: Behold therefore the kindness and severity of God upon indeed those having fallen severity toward however you kindness of God if you shall continue in the kindness otherwise also you yourself will be cut off.
verses.dgt: See then the kindness and severity of God: severity toward those who fell, but God’s kindness toward you, if you remain in the kindness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

verses.greek: κἀκεῖνοι δέ, ἐὰν μὴ ἐπιμένωσι τῇ ἀπιστίᾳ, ἐγκεντρισθήσονται· δυνατὸς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ θεὸς πάλιν ἐγκεντρίσαι αὐτούς.
verses.literal: And they now only unless they shall continue the in unbelief then they will be grafted in able for is the God again to graft in them
verses.dgt: And they also, if they do not remain in unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

greek.gloss: then they will be grafted in

literal.text: then they will be grafted in

verses.greek: εἰ γὰρ σὺ ἐκ τῆς κατὰ φύσιν ἐξεκόπης ἀγριελαίου καὶ παρὰ φύσιν ἐνεκεντρίσθης εἰς καλλιέλαιον, πόσῳ μᾶλλον οὗτοι οἱ κατὰ φύσιν ἐγκεντρισθήσονται τῇ ἰδίᾳ ἐλαίᾳ.
verses.literal: If for you yourself out of the according to nature were cut off a wild olive tree and contrary to nature were grafted into a cultivated olive tree how much more these who according to nature are will be grafted into their own olive tree?
verses.dgt: For if you were cut from what is by nature a wild olive tree and, contrary to nature, were grafted into a cultivated olive tree, how much more will these, the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

verses.greek: Οὐ γὰρ θέλω ὑμᾶς ἀγνοεῖν, ἀδελφοί, τὸ μυστήριον τοῦτο, ἵνα μὴ ἦτε ἑαυτοῖς φρόνιμοι, ὅτι πώρωσις ἀπὸ μέρους τῷ Ἰσραὴλ γέγονεν ἄχρι οὗ τὸ πλήρωμα τῶν ἐθνῶν εἰσέλθῃ,
verses.literal: Not for I want you to be ignorant brothers of the mystery this that not you may be yourselves wise that a hardening in part the to Israel has happened until that the fullness of the Gentiles may come in
verses.dgt: For I do not want you to be unaware of this mystery, brothers and sisters, so that you may not be wise in yourselves: a partial hardening has happened to Israel until the fullness of the Gentiles comes in,

verses.greek: καὶ οὕτως πᾶς Ἰσραὴλ σωθήσεται· καθὼς γέγραπται· Ἥξει ἐκ Σιὼν ὁ ῥυόμενος, ἀποστρέψει ἀσεβείας ἀπὸ Ἰακώβ.
verses.literal: and so all Israel will be saved even as it has been written: Will come out of Zion the One Delivering He will remove ungodliness from Jacob
verses.dgt: and in this way all Israel will be saved, just as it is written, “The Deliverer will come from Zion; he will turn ungodliness away from Jacob.

verses.greek: καὶ αὕτη αὐτοῖς ἡ παρʼ ἐμοῦ διαθήκη, ὅταν ἀφέλωμαι τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν.
verses.literal: And this is to them the from Me covenant when I may take away the sins of them.
verses.dgt: And this is my covenant with them, when I take away their sins.”

verses.greek: κατὰ μὲν τὸ εὐαγγέλιον ἐχθροὶ διʼ ὑμᾶς, κατὰ δὲ τὴν ἐκλογὴν ἀγαπητοὶ διὰ τοὺς πατέρας·
verses.literal: As regards indeed the gospel they are enemies on account of you As regards however the election beloved on account of the patriarchs
verses.dgt: According to the good news they are enemies for your sake, but according to election they are loved for the sake of the fathers,

verses.greek: ἀμεταμέλητα γὰρ τὰ χαρίσματα καὶ ἡ κλῆσις τοῦ θεοῦ.
verses.literal: Irrevocable for are the gifts and the calling the of God.
verses.dgt: for the gracious gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

verses.greek: ὥσπερ γὰρ ὑμεῖς ποτε ἠπειθήσατε τῷ θεῷ, νῦν δὲ ἠλεήθητε τῇ τούτων ἀπειθείᾳ,
verses.literal: Just as for you yourselves once were disobedient the to God now however were shown mercy to them through their disobedience
verses.dgt: For just as you once disobeyed God but now received mercy because of their disobedience,

verses.greek: οὕτως καὶ οὗτοι νῦν ἠπείθησαν τῷ ὑμετέρῳ ἐλέει ἵνα καὶ αὐτοὶ νῦν ἐλεηθῶσιν·
verses.literal: so also these now were disobedient the to your mercy so that also they themselves now may have mercy shown them.
verses.dgt: so these also now disobeyed because of the mercy shown to you, so that they themselves also may now receive mercy.

verses.greek: συνέκλεισεν γὰρ ὁ θεὸς τοὺς πάντας εἰς ἀπείθειαν ἵνα τοὺς πάντας ἐλεήσῃ.
verses.literal: Has bound up for the God the all in disobedience that the all He may show mercy to.
verses.dgt: For God shut up all in disobedience so that he might show mercy to all.

verses.greek: Ὦ βάθος πλούτου καὶ σοφίας καὶ γνώσεως θεοῦ· ὡς ἀνεξεραύνητα τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνεξιχνίαστοι αἱ ὁδοὶ αὐτοῦ.
verses.literal: O the depth of riches both of wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable the judgments of Him and untraceable the ways of Him!
verses.dgt: Oh, the depth of the riches and wisdom and knowledge of God! How unsearchable his judgments and untraceable his ways!

verses.greek: Τίς γὰρ ἔγνω νοῦν κυρίου; ἢ τίς σύμβουλος αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο;
verses.literal: Who for has known the mind of the Lord? or who counselor of Him has been?
verses.dgt: “For who knew the mind of the Lord, or who became his counselor?

verses.greek: ἢ τίς προέδωκεν αὐτῷ, καὶ ἀνταποδοθήσεται αὐτῷ;
verses.literal: Or who has first given to Him and it will be recompensed to him?
verses.dgt: Or who first gave to him, and it will be repaid to him?”

verses.greek: ὅτι ἐξ αὐτοῦ καὶ διʼ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα· αὐτῷ ἡ δόξα εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας, ἀμήν.
verses.literal: For from Him and through Him and unto Him the are all things To Him be the glory to the ages! Amen.
verses.dgt: Because from him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory forever. Amen.
